evidence: The ALD chamber was heated and stabilized for 30 min before supplying the reactants. The MoS2 film was formed using a sequence of MoCl5 (99.6%, STREM Chemical, Massachusetts, USA) and H2S (3.99% balance N2, JC Gas, Korea) as the reaction precursors under the carrier gas of N2 (5N, JC Gas, Korea).
